content: Operating files live in .ai. Chats are copied by copy_chats.py. Journal entries are appended only through organize.py against journal-entry.schema.json.
Each .ai context is one module folder. The checker discovers module.json and does not keep a central list of contexts.
Foreign code is a source. Intake decision is write-here: name the owner, the spec, and a whole-behavior proof, then code it in that module. decision import is rejected by schema/intake.schema.json.

cargo build -p shippin-tech --config build.rustc-wrapper= empty, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1, exited 0 in 2m 15s. target/debug/shippin-tech.exe written 2026-10-29T22:39:50, 168851968 bytes. Default features rocks and enterprise. Build phase exit proof observed.

One Rocks node at D:/localdev/mail-shippin/one-node/rocks, domain example.org, mailbox admin@example.org. SMTP on port 25 queued message 337765459443056640 and local delivery ingested it into INBOX. IMAPS on port 993 selected INBOX and returned the body rocks-mailbox-proof-token-2026-10-29.

afterAgentThought writes the full thinking text to chats reasoning.jsonl as kind thought. preCompact writes kind compaction. The session event keeps the raw payload, including duration_ms. Past thoughts were not on disk, so they cannot be backfilled.

The scale binary writes the existing BlobStore S3 and Coordinator NATS singletons from shippin.tech_SCALE_S3_ENDPOINT, shippin.tech_SCALE_S3_ACCESS_KEY, shippin.tech_SCALE_S3_SECRET_KEY, and shippin.tech_SCALE_NATS_ADDRESS when those singletons are empty. A partial set writes nothing. deployable-product stays in_progress until the Dockerfile.fdb container is started.

scale_two_nodes passed in 16.66s. Tenant A message written on node A was read on node B. Tenant B Mailbox/get returned forbidden. Both nodes redirected JMAP, CalDAV, and CardDAV discovery. cargo build -p shippin-tech exited 0. The scale env unit test passed.

Client sequence is recorded and not started. After shippin.cloud hosts the deployable image: web and phone mailbox on JMAP, CalDAV, and CardDAV. Control plane stays the existing directory and is white-label and enterprise only. Then a separate docs product. Then photos sync and phone backup on urn:ietf:params:jmap:filenode. deployable-product stays in_progress.

UI standard recorded. /admin and /account are rebuilt later with shippin.tech style tokens on an A2UI v0.9.1 catalog the client owns. Folders are domain/feature with provenance ai-runtime, admin/ai, admin/chat, and adapter. Adapter is the only door into the Rust engine. Chat index paths now point at the D: tree.

Application UI is SvelteKit and Svelte 5. Svelte Flow graphs render catalog component ids. Routes and ai-runtime may call adapter. Catalog and tokens do not. component.json is discovered, not registered. Old /admin and /account HTML converts into this app.

UI folders use the kebab-case of existing Rust modules. calendar_event stays calendar_event in crates/jmap and becomes catalog/calendar-event. Adapter calls only the paths in crates/http/src/request.rs. Rust files are not renamed. No SvelteKit app is added to the workspace.

Existing screens login and calendar-rsvp now live in ui/ as Svelte 5. calendar-invite and calendar-alarm stay HTML mail bodies. Kernels are ui/src/lib/ai-runtime/mail, docs, and control-plane, each with threads. The engine still embeds the gzipped HTML until that static build is wired in. npm run check and npm run build in ui/ exited 0.

Public Svelte screens are sign-in and calendar RSVP. npm run check exited 0. The control plane screens live on local branch control-plane (e0d54c5) and were removed from local main in c704545. That deletion is not pushed. origin/main is still f30f333, so the control plane files are already in the public history.

The Svelte app now renders HTML on the first response. Harbor and Kelp are the light and dark themes in ui/src/lib/token/color.css. They are configurable, not white and black, and the listed pairs meet WCAG AA. The choice is data-theme and localStorage key shippin-theme.

The first UI milestone is shippin-renders. Every original render in resources/html-templates gets the shippin brand, Harbor and Kelp, including the minified bytes the engine serves. The license stays deciding.
The UI to convert is the portal already in assets/webui, version 2.0.4. It was built for running mail on a domain. The empty Svelte shells are not that portal.

The Svelte conversion follows assets/webui in this order: sign-in, bootstrap, dashboard, then one schema-driven list and form from GET /api/schema. The plan is .ai/modules/plans/data/2026-11-04-portal-to-svelte.json and its status is draft.

The portal tokens replace the plain theme. Light is #f5f2ec and #1c1a17 with primary #db2d54. Dark is the class dark. Type is Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono. ThemeChoice is system, light, or dark. --warning stays #a16207. --warning-text is #7c4c05 because the portal warning on the page background is 4.41.

The rose primary is replaced by the cyber palette. Primary is neon green #39ff14. Electric burnt gold is #ffb000. Cyber pink is #ff2bd6. Light text shades are #0b6b32, #7a4e00, and #b0006a. Dark keeps the bright swatches.

The viewport is typed in ui/src/lib/token/viewport.ts as 320 to 1240. utopia-core writes the clamps. --x-* uses vi and --y-* uses vb. Image slots are --img-s, --img-m, and --img-l. Width breakpoints are gone. Each color is one light-dark() value.

The full UI transition of assets/webui comes first. The Astro landing is the next plan and stays draft until that transition is implemented. The landing is static HTML that says shippin.tech is the mail server for a domain. robots.txt, a sitemap, schema.org, and llms.txt publish that page to public crawlers. The landing does not host the password form and does not scrape other sites.
The Svelte app renders the portal schema: Management, Settings, and Account, 86 views. Lists stay empty and forms stay read-only until the engine fills them.
Portal views load through object/get. Signed out, Domains links to sign-in. Signed in, example.org fills the domain form and Mailbox/get lists Inbox, Sent Items, Junk Mail, Drafts, and Deleted Items.

The dashboard shows Last 24 hours through Last 90 days and All nodes. GET /api/token/metrics is refused on this build, and both /portal and the Dashboard nav item say the server refused the live metrics stream.

The dashboard draws Management, Settings, and Account as Svelte Flow graphs from the portal catalog, 108 nodes across three graphs. Delivery tests draws MX Lookup through DANE Verify in one row. Clicking the Domains node opened /portal/x:Domain and showed example.org. The catalog does not import the flow.

Indexed assets/webui 2.0.4 against the Svelte app. 23 portal surfaces: 7 done, 6 partial, 10 remaining. Schema has 150 objects and the layouts name 86 views. Fixed screens are the chunk names, not the hashes. Schema screens regenerate from emit-portal.

Continue on sign-in calls GET /api/discover. This server returns authorization_endpoint /login and no client id, so the password step stays. Signing in after that reached /portal. A document with client metadata redirects. The token exchange page is still remaining.

Direct sign-in registers a public client, returns to /login with the PKCE query, exchanges the code on /oauth/callback, and opens the portal with a Bearer session. prove-portal-discover printed ok. svelte-check found 0 errors and 0 warnings. GET /jmap/session with that bearer returned 200 for admin@example.org.

Portal search opens from the shell and from Ctrl K. A domains query lists the Domains page, and choosing it opens /portal/x:Domain. Escape closes the dialog. prove-portal-search printed ok. svelte-check found 0 errors and 0 warnings.

A non-empty form value has Copy plus the field name. On the domain form, Copy Domain Name showed the blocked-clipboard sentence because this browser refused both the clipboard and the manual command. prove-portal-copy printed ok. svelte-check found 0 errors and 0 warnings. The remaining sequence is still draft.

The UI review keeps the catalog, adapter, and tokens. Vitest and Playwright come before the next management screen. layerchart, bits-ui, CodeMirror, and the date library install with the screen that renders them. A document editor stays out of this repository. No packages were installed.

Portal structure is in place. Catalog fields keep schema type and format. PortalView is split into DashboardPanel, RecordTable, and RecordForm. Vitest 5 passed, svelte-check found 0 errors, and the Playwright search dialog passed axe.
Bootstrap wizard renders five schema steps with bits-ui. An empty x:Bootstrap/get stays on the portal. Finish does not post. Proof ok. svelte-check found 0 errors.
The work is converting assets/webui. The component primitive is bits-ui.
The bootstrap wizard renders five schema steps with bits-ui. An empty x:Bootstrap/get stays on the portal. /setup does not post x:Bootstrap/set. Nested variant fields are still the variant name.

Dashboard metrics parse the live frame and retry five times. A chart mounts only when points exist. This server still shows the metrics refusal and does not open the stream. Proof ok. svelte-check found 0 errors.
Schema writes render Create, Save, and a delete confirmation. registrySet builds the call. The route does not post it. Save says there are no changes. Proof ok. svelte-check found 0 errors.
Delivery runner validates a target and parses a stage frame. Start trace does not open /api/live/delivery. Browser confirmed no delivery request. Proof ok. svelte-check found 0 errors.

Trace timeline and detail render from a parsed frame. Live Tracing starts only with a session and opens the stream only with a token. Signed-out browser click fetched nothing. Proof ok. svelte-check found 0 errors.
Actions lists the 11 schema variants and confirms before running. Execute shows Action failed and does not post x:Action/set. Browser confirmed no action post. Proof ok. svelte-check found 0 errors.
The HTTP server resolves portal pages to ui/build/200.html and does not take /api, /admin, or /account. The portal_file test passed. The running process was not restarted.
The rebuilt server on port 8080 serves ui/build. GET /portal is the Svelte page. The script asset is JavaScript. /healthz/live stays problem+json. /admin is not the Svelte page.
Hosting images build the Svelte portal and install it at /usr/share/shippin.tech/portal. The lookup uses that path. Docker is not installed here, so the image stage was not built on this machine.
